name: Eleanor
saga: Map-Making with Eleanor the Wandering Fairy
description_en: A young fairy with translucent butterfly wings that shimmer in light, long flowing golden hair, a lavender dress decorated with tiny stars, pointed ears, bright green eyes, bare feet. Graceful and curious expression.
